channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Ruben Gallego backs Graham Platner as Democrats split over Maine Senate race
item.description: The backing follows endorsements from Bernie Sanders and New Mexico Sen. Martin Heinrich.

item.title: Supreme Court preserves only GOP-held congressional district in New York City for 2026 elections
item.description: The outcome is a victory for Republicans in a national tug-of-war over redistricting.

item.title: DeBrincat, Raymond each have goal, assist and Red Wings top Preds 4-2
item.description: Alex DeBrincat and Lucas Raymond each scored a goal and added an assist and Cam Talbot made 18 saves in relief of John Gibson to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 4-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Monday.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: Religious parents and educators challenged California policies aimed at preventing schools from outing children.

item.title: Troy police to buy $99K Ford Bronco for community engagement after selling hot rod
item.description: The 1932 Coupe, seized in a 1991 drug raid, was in service for the department for three decades. It was auctioned off for $32,500 in 2022, with all of the funds going into the drug forfeiture fund.

item.title: In a first as president, Trump says he’ll attend the White House correspondents’ dinner
item.description: Trump skipped the dinner throughout his first term and also missed last year’s event.

item.title: Lamphere grappler Allie Matheney ready to go ‘above and beyond’ in third state finals appearance
item.description: Allie Matheney was just a 6-year-old prodigy when she first hit the mat as an aspiring wrestler.

item.title: Democrats’ newfound unity faces a test after US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: Some pro-Israel Democrats say they will not support a war powers vote to limit Trump.

item.title: Photo gallery of Ortonville Brandon and Flint Kearsley in D2 girls hoops district QF action
item.description: A young Ortonville Brandon team matched Flint Kearsley with a fierce intensity early, but experience won out in the end as the Blackhawks fell 48-34 in a D2 district quarterfinal matchup Monday, March 2, 2026 in Linden.

item.title: Ortonville Brandon falls in rubber match with Flint Kearsley in district QFs
item.description: When you start the season with six freshman and your experience is centered around three juniors, you expect it may be a long season.
